description: Duplicate-IP risk and diversity health across the fleet. Mixes current-state KPIs with time-window-aware comparisons. All rates use a time-aligned active-device denominator.

options.content:
**Two views combined.**

- **Right Now** panels (top stats, current-IP tables, geomap, server-pair, server within/cross): read live `proxies.last_ip`. Reflect the present moment. Time picker does not affect them.
- **Over Time Range** panels (city comparison, trends, frequency and severity): use the dashboard time picker. Rates are time-aligned: phone counts on duplicates are divided by phones online in the matching 5-minute window, using the actual active count observed for each city.

**Snapshot / check** = an automatic scan run every few minutes that records every IP currently shared by two or more phones.

**Filters:** Proxy Status (Active default), City (multi-select, All), Min Active Devices (hide tiny cities).

**Notes when reading numbers:**
- *Observations* / *appearances* multiply by time — the same IP counts again every check it persisted. NOT a phone count.
- *Distinct* counts deduplicate across checks. Compare these to fleet size.
- *Peak* / *worst* columns are MAX across checks, never averages.

panels.description: Current number of duplicated outbound IPs for the selected cities. Each value is one IP currently shared by 2+ selected phones. Reflects this moment, not the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (
  SELECT last_ip
  FROM proxies
  WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip != ''
    AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR TRIM(city) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
  GROUP BY last_ip
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) AS dup_ips

panels.title: Top Duplicate IPs by Phone Count (Right Now)

panels.description: Cities currently having the most phones on duplicate IPs (absolute counts).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(IFNULL(city,'Unknown'), ', ', IFNULL(state,'')) AS city_label,
  COUNT(*) AS affected_phones,
  COUNT(DISTINCT last_ip) AS duplicate_ips
FROM proxies
WHERE ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR TRIM(city) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
  AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
  AND last_ip IN (
    SELECT last_ip
    FROM proxies
    WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip != ''
      AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR TRIM(city) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
      AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')

panels.title: Cities w/ Most IP-Sharing Phones (Right Now)

panels.description: One row per current shared IP. Phone count, active/inactive split, phone names, device IDs, cities, countries.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  last_ip,
  COUNT(*) AS phone_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN proxy_status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN proxy_status = 'inactive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactive_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY name SEPARATOR ', ') AS phones,
  GROUP_CONCAT(device_id ORDER BY name SEPARATOR ', ') AS device_ids,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT IFNULL(city,'?') ORDER BY city SEPARATOR ', ') AS cities,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT IFNULL(country,'?') ORDER BY country SEPARATOR ', ') AS countries
FROM proxies
WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip != ''
  AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR TRIM(city) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
  AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
GROUP BY last_ip
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY phone_count DESC, last_ip

panels.title: Duplicate IPs — One Row per Shared IP (Right Now)

panels.description: Current duplicate-IP impact by server label inferred from phone names (`S<n>P<m>` pattern). Higher = server contributes more duplicate exposure.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  server,
  COUNT(DISTINCT last_ip) AS duplicate_ips,
  COUNT(*) AS affected_phones
FROM (
  SELECT
    last_ip,
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(UPPER(name), 'P', 1), 'S', -1))
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS server
  FROM proxies
  WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip != ''
    AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR TRIM(city) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
    AND last_ip IN (
      SELECT last_ip
      FROM proxies
      WHERE last_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_ip != ''
        AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR TRIM(city) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
        AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
      GROUP BY last_ip
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    )
) AS t
GROUP BY server
ORDER BY duplicate_ips DESC, affected_phones DESC

panels.title: Duplicate IPs Per Server (Right Now)

panels.description: Splits current duplicate IPs by whether they sit on one server (within-server clustering) or span multiple servers (cross-server, carrier/IP-pool issue).

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(city) AS city
  FROM proxies
  WHERE city IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(city) != ''
    AND LOWER(TRIM(city)) NOT IN ('n/a','na')
    AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR TRIM(city) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
), latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(captured_at) AS captured_at
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows
  WHERE proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
), filtered_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.captured_at, r.proxy_status_scope, r.last_ip
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows r
  JOIN latest l ON l.captured_at = r.captured_at
  WHERE r.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
    AND r.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
    AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM selected_cities c
      WHERE LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', c.city, ','),  CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(r.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
         OR LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', c.city, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(r.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
    ))
), ip_server_counts AS (
  SELECT s.last_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(s.server_label)) AS distinct_servers_on_ip
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  JOIN filtered_rows r
    ON r.captured_at = s.captured_at
    AND r.proxy_status_scope = s.proxy_status_scope
    AND r.last_ip = s.last_ip
  GROUP BY s.last_ip
)
SELECT
  TRIM(s.server_label) AS server,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.distinct_servers_on_ip = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_server_dup_ips,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.distinct_servers_on_ip > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cross_server_dup_ips
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
JOIN filtered_rows r
  ON r.captured_at = s.captured_at
  AND r.proxy_status_scope = s.proxy_status_scope
  AND r.last_ip = s.last_ip
JOIN ip_server_counts c ON c.last_ip = s.last_ip
GROUP BY TRIM(s.server_label)
ORDER BY (within_server_dup_ips + cross_server_dup_ips) DESC, server

panels.title: Within vs Cross-Server Duplicate IPs (Right Now)

panels.description: Server pairs that share duplicated IPs. Computed from the latest snapshot in the time window. Replaces the O(N^2) self-join on the proxies table — uses pre-aggregated server labels.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(city) AS city
  FROM proxies
  WHERE city IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(city) != ''
    AND LOWER(TRIM(city)) NOT IN ('n/a','na')
    AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR TRIM(city) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
), latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(captured_at) AS captured_at
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows
  WHERE proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
), filtered_ips AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.captured_at, r.proxy_status_scope, r.last_ip
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows r
  JOIN latest l ON l.captured_at = r.captured_at
  WHERE r.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
    AND r.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
    AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM selected_cities c
      WHERE LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', c.city, ','),  CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(r.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
         OR LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', c.city, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(r.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
    ))
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(LEAST(TRIM(a.server_label), TRIM(b.server_label)),
         ' vs ',
         GREATEST(TRIM(a.server_label), TRIM(b.server_label))) AS server_pair,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.last_ip) AS shared_ips
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers a
JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers b
  ON a.captured_at = b.captured_at
 AND a.proxy_status_scope = b.proxy_status_scope
 AND a.last_ip = b.last_ip
 AND TRIM(a.server_label) < TRIM(b.server_label)
JOIN filtered_ips f
  ON f.captured_at = a.captured_at
 AND f.proxy_status_scope = a.proxy_status_scope
 AND f.last_ip = a.last_ip
GROUP BY server_pair
ORDER BY shared_ips DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.description: Per-city duplicate-IP frequency and severity over the selected time range. Active-device denominator is time-aligned (5-min bucket containing each check), using the actual active devices observed for that city. The honest answer to how often this city has duplicates, and how serious they are.

properties.value: Peak Dup IPs in One Check
Peak Phones on Dups in One Check

matcher.options: Peak Dup IPs in One Check

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(city) AS city
  FROM proxies
  WHERE city IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(city) != ''
    AND LOWER(TRIM(city)) NOT IN ('n/a','na')
    AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR TRIM(city) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
),
window_active AS (
  SELECT TRIM(p.city) AS city,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sm.proxy_id) AS active_devices_in_window
  FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary sm
  JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = sm.proxy_id
  JOIN selected_cities c ON c.city = TRIM(p.city)
  WHERE sm.window_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
  GROUP BY TRIM(p.city)
  HAVING active_devices_in_window >= ${min_active_devices}
),
snaps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT captured_at AS snapshot_at,
         FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(captured_at)/300)*300) AS bucket_start
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows
  WHERE captured_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
),
bucket_active AS (
  SELECT sm.window_start AS bucket_start,
         TRIM(p.city) AS city,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sm.proxy_id) AS active_devices
  FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary sm
  JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = sm.proxy_id
  JOIN window_active w ON w.city = TRIM(p.city)
  WHERE sm.window_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__timeTo()
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
  GROUP BY sm.window_start, TRIM(p.city)
),
snap_active AS (
  SELECT s.snapshot_at, b.city, b.active_devices
  FROM snaps s
  JOIN bucket_active b ON b.bucket_start = s.bucket_start
),
snap_dup AS (
  SELECT s.snapshot_at,
         w.city,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.last_ip) AS duplicate_ips_in_scan,
         SUM(r.phones_on_same_ip) AS phones_on_dup_in_scan,
         MAX(r.phones_on_same_ip) AS max_phones_per_ip
  FROM snaps s
  JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows r ON r.captured_at = s.snapshot_at
  JOIN window_active w
    ON LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', w.city, ','),  CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(r.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
    OR LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', w.city, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(r.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
  WHERE r.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
    AND r.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
  GROUP BY s.snapshot_at, w.city
),
distinct_ips AS (
  SELECT w.city,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.last_ip) AS distinct_dup_ips_in_window
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows r
  JOIN window_active w
    ON LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', w.city, ','),  CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(r.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
    OR LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', w.city, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(r.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
  WHERE r.captured_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
    AND r.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
  GROUP BY w.city
),
joined AS (
  SELECT sa.snapshot_at, sa.city, sa.active_devices,
         COALESCE(d.duplicate_ips_in_scan, 0) AS duplicate_ips_in_scan,
         COALESCE(d.phones_on_dup_in_scan, 0) AS phones_on_dup_in_scan,
         COALESCE(d.max_phones_per_ip, 0) AS max_phones_per_ip
  FROM snap_active sa
  LEFT JOIN snap_dup d
    ON d.snapshot_at = sa.snapshot_at AND d.city = sa.city
)
SELECT
  w.city,
  w.active_devices_in_window AS total_active_devices,
  COUNT(j.snapshot_at) AS scans_city_alive,
  SUM(CASE WHEN j.duplicate_ips_in_scan > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scans_with_duplicates,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN j.duplicate_ips_in_scan > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(j.snapshot_at), 0), 2) AS duplicate_scan_rate_pct,
  COALESCE(di.distinct_dup_ips_in_window, 0) AS distinct_dup_ips_in_window,
  SUM(j.phones_on_dup_in_scan) AS phone_on_dup_observations,
  SUM(j.active_devices) AS active_device_observations,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(j.phones_on_dup_in_scan) / NULLIF(SUM(j.active_devices), 0), 2) AS duplicate_phone_rate_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN j.duplicate_ips_in_scan > 0 THEN j.duplicate_ips_in_scan END), 2) AS avg_dup_ips_when_hit,
  MAX(j.duplicate_ips_in_scan) AS peak_dup_ips_in_scan,
  MAX(j.phones_on_dup_in_scan) AS peak_phones_on_dup_in_scan,
  MAX(j.max_phones_per_ip) AS peak_single_ip_load
FROM window_active w
LEFT JOIN joined j ON j.city = w.city
LEFT JOIN distinct_ips di ON di.city = w.city
GROUP BY w.city, w.active_devices_in_window, di.distinct_dup_ips_in_window
ORDER BY duplicate_phone_rate_pct DESC, w.city

panels.title: City Comparison — Duplicate Frequency & Severity (Actual City Counts)

panels.description: Daily distinct duplicate IP count per selected city across the time window. One line per city, one point per day. Uses the dashboard time picker.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(city) AS city
  FROM proxies
  WHERE city IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(city) != ''
    AND LOWER(TRIM(city)) NOT IN ('n/a','na')
    AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR TRIM(city) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(r.captured_at)) AS time_sec,
  c.city AS metric,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.last_ip) AS value
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows r
JOIN selected_cities c
  ON LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', c.city, ','),  CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(r.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
  OR LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', c.city, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(r.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
WHERE r.captured_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND r.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_status}'
  AND r.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(r.captured_at)), c.city
ORDER BY time_sec, metric

panels.title: Daily Distinct Duplicate IPs — Selected Cities

panels.description: IP rotation events per day, per selected city. Uses proxy_requests_daily_summary for completed historical days and proxy_requests_5min_summary for today, so 30-day ranges render beyond the short 5-minute-summary retention window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(city) AS city
  FROM proxies
  WHERE city IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(city) != ''
    AND LOWER(TRIM(city)) NOT IN ('n/a','na')
    AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR TRIM(city) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
),
rotation_points AS (
  SELECT
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(d.day) AS time_sec,
    TRIM(p.city) AS metric,
    SUM(d.ip_change_count) AS value
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary d
  JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = d.proxy_id
  JOIN selected_cities c ON c.city = TRIM(p.city)
  WHERE d.day >= DATE($__timeFrom())
    AND d.day <= DATE($__timeTo())
    AND d.day < CURDATE()
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
  GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(d.day), TRIM(p.city)

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(sm.window_start)) AS time_sec,
    TRIM(p.city) AS metric,
    SUM(sm.ip_change_count) AS value
  FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary sm
  JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = sm.proxy_id
  JOIN selected_cities c ON c.city = TRIM(p.city)
  WHERE sm.window_start BETWEEN GREATEST($__timeFrom(), CURDATE()) AND $__timeTo()
    AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
  GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(sm.window_start)), TRIM(p.city)
)
SELECT
  time_sec,
  metric,
  SUM(value) AS value
FROM rotation_points
GROUP BY time_sec, metric
ORDER BY time_sec, metric

panels.title: IP Rotation Events per Day — Selected Cities

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  TRIM(p.city) AS city,
  p.last_ip,
  COUNT(*) AS phones_sharing,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.proxy_status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.proxy_status = 'inactive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactive_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(p.name ORDER BY p.name SEPARATOR ' | ') AS phone_names,
  GROUP_CONCAT(p.device_id ORDER BY p.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS device_ids
FROM proxies p
WHERE p.last_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.last_ip != ''
  AND ('${proxy_status}' = 'all' OR proxy_status = '${proxy_status}')
  AND ('${city:raw}' = '$__all' OR TRIM(p.city) IN (${city:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY TRIM(p.city), p.last_ip
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY TRIM(p.city), phones_sharing DESC
